Numbers and limits

The current game has no fixed per-person waiting-order limit. The visible preview shows as many as fit without discarding the rest. A separate command buffer can refuse a burst of new inputs; the status reports an unaccepted instruction.

urlWaitLimit: Driver exact-hash wait timed out despite actual UI elements document and #land. CDP frame.url plus urlFragment and DOM URL independently identify navigation; failed observations preserved separately.
noJavaScript: Not executed through Cua; no exposed script-disable method. Pending alternate-driver static-guide verification.
